resolution.note: baseline, final-tree and Stop-gate test runs rerun failing files once; passes are recorded as flaky

title: Lane runs rerun failing test files once and record flaky tests instead of a red base
body:
Why: pilot lanes in seo-audit-harness exited 72/73/74 on load-dependent 5000 ms test timeouts (tests/cli/url-language.test.ts; .krn/runs/units-ts/lanes/*.run1.log); reruns merged. KRN cannot tell a flaky test from a red base or a broken change, so unattended drains stop on host load.
Outcome: when the baseline or the final-tree test run fails, krn lane run reruns only the failing test files once; a failure that passes on rerun is recorded as flaky (named in the lane summary and PR body) and does not count as red; a failure that repeats stays red. The same rule applies to the Stop gate's related-test run.
Proof: tests with a stubbed test runner (fail-then-pass is flaky, fail-fail is red); npm run fast PASS.
